situation: Told my manager Priya in person today that I'm leaving for a job at a fintech startup. Need to send the formal written notice email now. Been there 4 years, she promoted me twice.
reply:
Hi Priya,
Following our conversation this morning, this is my formal notice of resignation. My last day will be Friday 31 October. Thank you for the past four years, and especially for pushing me to lead the billing migration when I wasn't sure I was ready. I'll have the handover doc to you by Friday and will make sure nothing drops before I go.
Best,
Mateo
note: The written note is a record, not the conversation: date, one specific thanks, the handover.

situation: 我在一个读书会当了两年组织者，现在工作太忙想退出，想在群里说一声，下个月的活动我负责的场地已经订好了。
reply: 各位书友，想跟大家说一声：我这学期结束后就不再担任读书会的组织者了。这两年跟大家一起读书特别开心，只是最近工作实在排不开，不想因为我拖了大家的节奏。11月15号那场的场地我已经订好，会办完再交接，也很乐意帮下一任组织者熟悉流程。谢谢大家！
note: 给出明确日期，说清收尾和交接，理由一句就够，不多解释。

situation: I resigned from my marketing job, my boss Greg offered me a 15% raise to stay. I've already signed with the new company. How do I say no without him getting weird for my last 3 weeks?
reply: I appreciate that, Greg, genuinely, and it means a lot that you'd make that offer. I've made my decision and I'd like to keep it clean. What I'd like is to make these three weeks as useful as possible, so tell me what you most want nailed down in the handover and I'll start there.
note: Hold the decision, don't re-argue the reason, and turn straight to the handover.

situation: I've done the books for a family bakery on a $600/month retainer for five years. I'm starting a full-time job in January and need to end it. The owner Carla has always been lovely. I called her yesterday, now I want to put it in writing.
reply:
Hi Carla,
Thanks for taking my call yesterday. To confirm in writing: I'll be ending our bookkeeping arrangement, and December will be my last month. I'll close out the year-end accounts before I go, write up a handover for whoever takes over, and I'm happy to spend an hour with them in person. If it helps, I can recommend two bookkeepers I'd trust with Ferro's. Thank you for five really good years, and for all the Friday focaccia.
Best,
Dev
note: Ending a client relationship follows the same shape as a resignation: tell them by phone, then a written note with the date, a real handover and a specific thanks.

situation: I gave notice yesterday, last day is Friday Oct 23. My manager Dave just replied on Slack: 'Honestly didn't expect this from you, leaving right before the Q4 launch really puts us in a hole.' I've been there 3 years.
reply: I understand the timing is hard, Dave, and I'm sorry it lands right before the launch. My decision is made and my last day stays Friday 23 October. I want these weeks to be useful, so I've started a handover doc for the launch checklist and can walk Leila through the vendor contacts on Thursday. Tell me what you'd most like prioritised and I'll start there.
note: After a guilt-trip, hold the date, don't re-argue the reason, and turn the conversation into a handover question.

situation: I started at a logistics startup in June and I'm quitting after 4 months. The role turned out to be mostly sales, which isn't what I signed up for. My manager Beth has been kind and I feel terrible. Meeting her tomorrow, what do I say?
reply: Beth, I wanted to tell you in person: I've decided to leave, and I'm giving my two weeks' notice today, so my last day would be Wednesday 14 October. The role has turned out to be different from what I'm looking for, and I'd rather say that early than let it drag. Before I go I'll write up the status of all 23 open accounts and hand over the Harlow onboarding properly. Thank you for all the time you've put into getting me started.
note: A short tenure needs less explanation, not more: one honest line about fit, a clear date, a concrete handover, no apology tour.

situation: 大学3年生で、駅前のカフェで2年間アルバイトをしている。就活に集中したいので11月末で辞めたい。店長の佐藤さんにはとてもお世話になった。明日のシフト後に直接話すつもりだけど、何と言えばいい？
reply: 佐藤さん、少しお時間よろしいですか。就職活動に集中するため、11月30日の勤務を最後に辞めさせていただきたいと思っています。早めにお伝えしたくて、今日お話ししました。それまでのシフトはこれまで通り入りますし、新しい方が入ったら、レジと閉店作業は私がお教えします。2年間、未経験の私に一から教えてくださって、本当にありがとうございました。
note: A part-time job gets the same shape as any resignation: in person, the date first, one reason, a concrete handover and a specific thanks.
